CONSUMER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Consumer Services Agreement is between Lumen Streaming Inc. ("Company") and the individual consumer who subscribes to the Service ("Subscriber"). Subscriber is a consumer purchasing the Service for personal, family and household use. Subscriber is a California resident who performs no work for Company outside California.

1. Governing Law

1.1 This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Texas, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles.

1.2 This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State applicable to the transaction, without reference to any particular jurisdiction.

1.3 Any employment or engagement of a worker residing and working in California under this Agreement shall nevertheless be governed by the laws of the State of Nevada.

2. Venue and Forum

2.1 The parties irrevocably submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York for any action arising out of this Agreement.

2.2 Notwithstanding Section 2.1, any dispute relating to the Company's intellectual property shall be brought exclusively in the courts of Tehran, Islamic Republic of Iran.

3. Dispute Resolution

3.1 Any dispute, claim or controversy arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be resolved by final and binding arbitration administered on an individual basis only. Subscriber waives any right to bring or participate in any class action, collective action, or class-wide arbitration against Company.

3.2 Subscriber waives the right to a trial by jury in any action arising out of this Agreement. Company retains all of its rights to a trial by jury in any such action.

3.3 Before commencing any action against Company, Subscriber shall give Company sixty (60) days' prior written notice of the claim and an opportunity to cure. Company may commence an action against Subscriber at any time without notice and without any cure period.

4. Miscellaneous

4.1 This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement of the parties.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement.
